driver: The decisive quantity is a forward dispersion with an absorbing agent removed: the agent traded against each interval's own shock and will stop, so the forward dispersion needs the outcome's response to the flow the agent absorbed, and because the agent's trades respond to the same interval's shock, the response read on the flow net of the agent is biased toward zero and the response read on the outside flow alone is net of the agent's offset; only the outside flow's response divided by the share of it the agent did not absorb (the outside flow as the instrument) puts the absorbed flow back at the market's own response.
driver_concrete: From 2024 to 2026 the Banco Central de Arauquia sold or bought dollars in the hours the peso moved most and absorbed a large share of each such hour's pressure, so the peso's realised volatility ran near 7 per cent; it stops on 4 January 2027. The hour's move regressed on the dealers' customer flow net of the bank's trades gives an impact biased low, because the bank traded against that hour's own move, and regressed on customer flow alone gives the impact net of the bank's offset; the customer flow's impact divided by one less the share of it the bank absorbed puts the bank's trades back at the market's own depth and gives a 2027 volatility near 11.5 per cent.
stump: A competent solver who takes the reference rate's realised volatility over 2024 to 2026 prices the 2027 options at 8 per cent, and one who adds the central bank's hourly trades back at the impact read from the hour's move on the market's net or customer flow prices at 9 or 10; the step that lands them there is reading the price impact off a regression whose flow the bank traded against within the same hour, when the customers' flow, scaled by the share of it the bank left to the market, gives the impact the float exposes and a 2027 volatility near 11.5 per cent, priced at 12.

lineage.driver: A forward period's count of threshold crossings is set by a component of the series that is deterministic and already known for that period, whose size in the period departs from its long-run average on cycles longer than a season, so the count has to be built from the period's own known component combined with the random remainder measured on the same grain in the same season, not read from the record's average crossing rate however it is trended.

lineage.niche: a western Washington paper mill's choice of waterway for the pipe bridge that carries its raw-water main over the river just below its own stage gauge: the 1 per cent annual chance peak discharge from the gauge's 46 annual peak stages, each turned into a discharge through a rating the mill's own field gaugings must supply, where about half the annual peaks rise onto the floodplain and the in-bank gaugings outnumber the floodplain ones five to one
lineage.driver: Each unit's outcome is a recorded index converted through a relation fitted to a separate and much smaller set of direct measurements, and the relation changes form above a level that about half the units exceed while few measurements do; one relation fitted to all the measurements is set by the many below the level, understates every unit above it by more the higher it sits, and through the fitted distribution's shape understates the rare quantile far more than it misstates any single unit.
lineage.driver_concrete: The 46 annual peak stages at TUM-02 become discharges only through a rating fitted to the company's 468 gaugings; above about 10.3 ft the river spills onto its left-bank pasture and the 79 gaugings made there run 13 per cent and more above any single power-law rating fitted to all of them (in-bank residuals within 4 per cent), so the peaks above the bank are understated, the station skew falls from -0.2 to -0.9 and the 1 per cent flood from 14,000 to 10,000 cfs; a rating with its own floodplain term above a break fitted at 10.28 ft, carried through every peak stage, gives 14,000 cfs and Alternative D (14,700 cfs), every floodplain-honouring form agreeing within 2.3 per cent.
lineage.stump: A competent solver who fits one power-law rating to all the gaugings and runs the standard's weighted-skew log-Pearson Type III on the converted peaks files a 1 per cent flood of 10,000 cfs and Alternative A (10,400 cfs), 12,000 cfs and Alternative C (12,900 cfs) if the curve is fitted in arithmetic units, because the floodplain gaugings that bend the rating upward above the bank are a sixth of the record; the rating with a floodplain term above the fitted 10.28 ft break puts the 1 per cent flood at 14,000 cfs and files Alternative D (14,700 cfs).
lineage.answer: Carry forward Alternative D (14,700 cfs) for the Sauer pipe bridge. The 1 per cent annual chance peak discharge at TUM-02 is 14,000 cfs, so Alternative C (12,900 cfs) falls short.

notes: Rebuild of task178, architecture 3 of the slot. stump_strategy causal_design: simultaneity, the agent's trades respond to the same hour's shock, so the comparison the design implies is the exogenous customer flow (not the net flow); not maturity_censoring, not composition_mix. Gate G method_or_model_selection: two defensible estimators of the market's price impact (the hour's move on the net or the customer flow, against the customer flow scaled by the share the bank left to the market, the customer flow as the instrument), the right one pinned by the data's structure, since the bank's trades grow with the same hour's move. Decisive generator G5 (provision elsewhere: the customers' dollar need was partly met by the central bank, so the record's prices never absorbed it), G16 (which estimator of the impact the data entitle), G17 (the margin of the instrument family against the pricing grid, asserted). task177's unregistered candidate G (dealer gamma damping) was the nearest screen and died on lever and family spread at plausible strength; here the absorbing agent's share is large and documented in its own log, and the family spread is measured at 2 to 4 per cent against a 30 per cent lever.
